title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 13507 Van Nuys Boulevard in Pacoima, California, as the Ritchie Valens Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 13507 Van Nuys Boulevard in Pacoima, California, as the "Ritchie Valens Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Pacoima, California post office after singer Ritchie Valens.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 13507 Van Nuys Boulevard in Pacoima, California, as the Ritchie Valens Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 12, 2019, and the new name applied from that date.
